reviewNotes: Independent source-quality audit: omit the 5.78M download figure and its publication date because the historical measurement period has not been independently established. A current weekly download count cannot prove an earlier monthly or cumulative count. Stripe is a commercially interested vendor customer story: aggregate revenue and billing activity do not prove SDK-to-paid cohort conversion. GetLatka and pricing-blog revenue numbers are historical unaudited third-party estimates; do not present them as current verified ARR or derive a valuation multiple. Quoted session prices do not measure realised margins; self-hosting has operating costs. Public founder biographies do not establish a cap table or absence of other equity holders. Investor customer lists are interested claims, and Stripe billing integration does not establish that Stripe buys browser automation. Do not assert that competitors lack compliance capabilities from a comparison article. Keep these as explicit unknowns, and base the memo on the verified customer-attribution correction, the official Stagehand no-account requirement, and conditional next diligence actions.

Final evidence-quality constraint: the earlier draft still repeats unsupported metrics. OMIT all Stagehand download quantities and publication dates because the historical period was not validated. OMIT ARR estimates and derived valuation multiples; historical third-party estimates are not current audited ARR. OMIT claims of empirical margin compression: list prices do not measure margins, and self-hosting is not free. Aggregate vendor-reported revenue does not establish SDK cohort conversion. Do not describe investor/vendor customer lists as independent financial audits, or claim competitors lack compliance capabilities. Retain the real Contrary customer-attribution correction and official Stagehand MIT/no-account evidence. Describe developer distribution and willingness to pay as hypotheses. Return a concise qualitative decision with clear unknowns and concrete diligence actions. No false numerical precision.
